topics.title: -ING ou TO: padrões fixos
rules: enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, consider, mind, keep + -ING
want, decide, plan, agree, expect, manage, refuse + TO
want / ask / tell + pessoa + TO: I want you to check it.
make / let + pessoa + verbo base, sem TO: Let me explain.
Depois de preposição, sempre -ING: before signing, thanks for coming.
TO preposição pede -ING: look forward to hearing, be used to working.

topics.title: -ING ou TO: mudam o sentido
topics.short: stop, remember, forget, try, regret, mean, need
rules: STOP + -ING = parar de · STOP + TO = parar para
REMEMBER / FORGET + TO = tarefa · + -ING = memória do passado
TRY + TO = esforçar-se · TRY + -ING = testar uma solução
REGRET + -ING = arrepender-se · REGRET TO inform = lamentar informar
MEAN + TO = ter a intenção · MEAN + -ING = implicar
Coisa que NEED algo: needs fixing / needs to be fixed

topics.title: Word families
topics.short: A classe gramatical certa para cada posição
rules: Depois de a / the / my: substantivo (a decision)
Antes de substantivo ou depois de be / very: adjetivo (very successful)
Modificando um verbo: advérbio (speaks clearly)
good → well · hard ≠ hardly · late ≠ lately
-ER faz a ação (employer) · -EE recebe (employee)

topics.title: Sufixos e prefixos
rules: Substantivos: -tion, -ment, -ness, -ity, -ance, -ship, -al
Pessoas: -er/-or, -ist, -ant/-ent, -ee
Adjetivos: -ful, -less, -able, -ive, -al, -ous
Verbos: -ize, -en, -ify, -ate
Negativos: un-, in-, im- (p/m/b), ir- (r), il- (l), dis-, non-
Sentido: re- (de novo), mis- (errado), over- / under-, pre-
